newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 16.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 16.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Friday the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
A weak stationary cold front was expected to move toward the Gulf of Mexico, bringing lower temperatures and stronger winds to the region possibly this weekend.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Clear skies and warm temperatures with winds 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to seven feet high. Some light rains along coasts of Michoacan, Guerrero and Oaxaca.

Rains and strong winds gusts expected along coasts of Tamaulipas, Veracruz, Tabasco and the Yucatan peninsula as a cold front approaches the region. Winds from 10 to 15 knots with waves four to six feet high.
Hot and partly cloudy with some rains and winds expected later in the day. winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
